main.description: The spaces written to since `cursor`, of the private repositories whose owners invited the caller (dev.knotless.inviteRunner), as their authorities told the appview (com.atproto.space.notifySpaceUpdate, while a credential the appview asked for registers it): nothing written in a space reaches the firehose. Answers as soon as there is one, or with none after a while, to be asked again from the cursor it gives. A write told of is only a reason to look: the caller reads the space itself, as a member. Requires a service token from the caller's PDS, audience the appview's DID, for this method.

cursor.description: Where this answer ended: the cursor to ask from next.

missed.description: Set when `cursor` was none, or of no place the appview remembers, as after it restarted: any space may have been written to since.

cursor.description: Where the last answer ended. With none, the answer says only where things are now.

description: A runner's ask of the appview for the private repositories written to, as soon as one is.
